module: Flowgraph node "Set Object Field" (repeat_instant). Modifies a field of a scene object by id. Inputs: objectId, fieldName, fieldArrayNum (hidden, 0), value (any; a table is converted to a space-separated string). Output: objectFound. Uses setField if the field is declared, otherwise setDynDataFieldbyName, then updateInstanceRenderData if available.
notes: Does nothing if value is nil or false (test `not value`): impossible to write false with this node.
Tables are concatenated by table.concat: only valid for lists of numbers/strings.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Looks up the object, converts the value and writes it to the field (declared or dynamic).
